problem_statement: getastrothemes lumio-lite-astro is a runnable multi-page Astro service site (Home, a /services/ listing, individual service-detail pages, a contact form) with a shared header/footer, an English/French language switcher, and the Lumio editorial visual system (black-and-white spacing, blue primary #2563ff, green #9ECF59 secondary accent, light #f5f3ef surfaces, a dark #141414 footer band, rounded media and numbered service rows). The site is an AI implementation studio whose five services are AI Readiness Review, Workflow Automation, Data Platform Engineering, AI Security Review and Adoption Enablement. The studio wants a native 'Service planner' at the top of the /services/ listing: an on-brand Lumio light card (light #f5f3ef surface, blue #2563ff accent title and active-tab fill, green #9ECF59 secondary edge, #222 text) with a 'Plan your engagement' heading, a discipline filter (All disciplines, Strategy, Engineering, Security, Adoption), a live 'Showing N of 5' readout, and a filtered grid of the five service cards. The same planner header should also sit at the top of the home page's services section and on each service-detail page so a visitor sees the same discipline browser everywhere. A previous revision shipped this planner but (a) pinned the tab row and card grid to a fixed-width no-wrap track that overflows a 390px phone, (b) styled it as a plain neutral-gray slab instead of the Lumio light/blue card, and (c) only rendered it on the /services/ listing. Rework the Service planner so it lays out responsively with no horizontal overflow on mobile, keeps the Lumio black/white/blue card styling, renders consistently across the home, /services/ and service-detail surfaces, and keeps the discipline filter wired so the readout and the filtered cards always reflect the active discipline after a click. Keep the five service names, the discipline labels, and the footer/header/route structure exactly as shipped; the fix must live in the Service planner component's own file.
required_content: The Service planner renders on the home page, the /services/ listing and each service-detail page with the 'Plan your engagement' heading, the four discipline tabs (Strategy, Engineering, Security, Adoption) plus 'All disciplines', and a card for each of the five services (AI Readiness Review, Workflow Automation, Data Platform Engineering, AI Security Review, Adoption Enablement).
On a 390px mobile view the tab row and card grid lay out without any horizontal document overflow (no horizontal scrollbar).

The planner keeps the Lumio light/blue card surface: light #f5f3ef background, blue #2563ff accent title and active-tab fill, rounded green-edged service cards, matching the surrounding Lumio chrome (not an off-brand gray or dark slab).
Clicking a discipline tab re-filters the service cards and re-syncs the 'Showing N of 5' readout so both reflect the active discipline after each click (for example, Engineering shows 2 of 5).
Header navigation, the language switcher, service rows, service-detail media and the contact form fields remain present and the site builds with the existing Astro pipeline.
Existing local imagery and the Lumio palette remain integrated; no external stock imagery, remote fonts, analytics or network calls are introduced.
design_constraints: Preserve the Lumio visual language: black/white editorial spacing, blue #2563ff primary, green #9ECF59 secondary accent, light #f5f3ef surfaces, the dark #141414 footer band, rounded media and numbered service rows.
Keep the five service names and the discipline labels identical; only the planner's responsive layout, surface styling, cross-page presence and filter wiring may change.
The change must live in the Service planner component's own file; do not alter the header, the service rows, the service-detail body, the contact form or other page bodies.
The tab row and card grid must wrap or otherwise reflow so a 390px viewport shows no horizontal overflow, while the desktop and tablet layouts stay visually stable.
Do not introduce external stock imagery, remote fonts, analytics or network calls; every page must stay runtime-clean (no console or network errors).
state_constraints: desktop_planner_services captures the Service planner at 1440px at the top of the /services/ listing, on the Lumio light card surface, laying out without overflow on every leg.

mobile_planner_services captures the planner at 390px: on the shipped (defective) revision the fixed-width no-wrap tab row and card grid push the document past the viewport, a horizontal-scroll defect the fix must remove.

desktop_planner_services, desktop_planner_home and desktop_planner_detail all carry the shared planner in the reference; the planner must be present on each of these three surfaces (cross-page consistency).

planner_filter_engineering clicks the Engineering discipline tab on the /services/ planner; after the click the readout must read 'Showing 2 of 5' and the grid shows the two Engineering services (Workflow Automation, Data Platform Engineering).

Source inspection confirms the planner is injected at the top of the services listing, the home services section and the service-detail page (identical wiring across legs); the planner reuses the Lumio blue/green palette from theme.css.

change_completion: The Service planner renders across the home, /services/ and service-detail surfaces with the five service cards and the discipline tabs.
Clicking a discipline tab re-filters the cards and re-syncs the 'Showing N of 5' readout so the terminal state reflects the active discipline.
The mobile planner shows no horizontal overflow after the fix.
design_consistency: The planner keeps the Lumio light card surface, rounded green-edged cards, blue accent title and active-tab fill on every surface.
Desktop and tablet layouts stay visually stable; only the mobile reflow changes.
regression: Header navigation, the language switcher, service rows, service-detail media and the contact form remain reachable and unchanged, and the build succeeds with the existing Astro pipeline.
Every page stays runtime-clean with no console or network errors.
responsive: 390px mobile planner has no horizontal document overflow.
The discipline tabs and service cards wrap intentionally on narrow viewports rather than forcing a fixed-width horizontal track.

author_notes: Repo-grounded Astro (getastrothemes lumio-lite-astro Lumio template) cross-page restyle / experience-continuity task, hardened to L4. The reference ships a native, responsive, on-brand Lumio 'Service planner' discipline filter at the top of the /services/ listing (and mirrored on the home services section and each service-detail page), with a wired discipline-filter control that re-renders the five service cards and re-syncs a 'Showing N of 5' readout. Content and DOM are byte-identical across the reference, the shipped-with-defect baseline and a shallow non-fix bad solution; only the Service planner component's file differs. The bad solution fails four orthogonal product gates: no_horizontal_overflow (mobile tab/card-row overflow), visual_regression (off-brand dark-violet slab with overlapping, clipped cards and an illegible active tab versus the Lumio light/blue card), cross-page dom_assertions (planner missing on the service-detail route), and interaction_assertions (the discipline filter click re-filters the cards but the readout stays frozen at 'Showing all 5'). The baseline reproduces the original three layout/visual/presence defects but keeps the filter wiring correct, so it fails the first three gates and passes the interaction gate. Local service imagery (service-1.png), the Lumio blue/green palette and the numbered service rows are reused; no remote fonts or stock imagery. Product-grade gates: enforce_console_errors (max 0), cross-page DOM assertions, visual_regression on in-viewport planner states, and an interaction-trajectory terminal-state assertion.

metadata.selected_repo_reason: lumio-lite-astro is a runnable multi-page Astro Lumio service template (home, /services/ listing, service-detail pages, contact) whose services listing is the natural home for a discipline filter; the cross-page restyle adds a native, responsive Service planner over the site's five real services, anchored on four orthogonal product gates (overflow, visual, cross-page presence, interaction terminal state).
